PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_RailingHandrail
PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: Railing designed to serve as an optional structural support for loads applied by human occupants (at hand height). Generally located adjacent to ramps and stairs. Generally floor or wall mounted..

PropertyDef.Name: HandrailHeight
PropertyDef.Definition: Height to top of handrail - from stair, landing or floor

PropertyDef.Name: MaxDistanceFromWall
PropertyDef.Definition: Distance from the wall to the handrail surface furthest from the wall. Value of 0.0 means value not set.
